title: WINDSHIELD GLASS & LOWER REVEAL MOLDING
summary: Windshield glass installation and the lower windshield reveal moldings (the trim along the bottom of the windshield at the cowl): the glass sits on spacers and is set in a 134-inch seal with primer and sealer; the center lower molding rides on the windshield wiper access door, held by clips and end screws; the LH/RH corner molding pieces are screwed down and clipped into the fender at the pillar.

fastening.note: Glass [1] is set in seal 70a over primer 76a (or optional 77a), with sealer 78b at the edge (View B).
Spacers [2] sit under the top edge of the glass, located 15.85 and 18.10 SYM from centerline.
Spacers [3] and [9] support the lower glass edge near each corner, set 20.75 and 18.15 SYM from centerline; glued with 51m adhesive.
View A: clips [8] hook over the edge of the wiper access door and hold the center molding [7]; keep .06 to .12 clearance between molding [7] and glass [1].
Screw [4] goes in from the side through the end of center molding [7].
Screw [6] goes down through the flange of corner molding [5].
View C: clip [10] snaps into a .156/.160 dia hole in the fender at the pillar end of molding [5].
